title: Salesforce Service Cloud Case
description: Schema for a Salesforce Service Cloud Case record representing a customer issue or support request.

Id.description: Unique Salesforce record identifier (15 or 18 character)

CaseNumber.description: Auto-generated unique case number for display purposes

Subject.description: Brief summary of the customer issue or request

Description.description: Detailed description of the customer issue

Status.description: Current status in the case lifecycle

Priority.description: Priority level indicating urgency of the case

Origin.description: Channel through which the case was created

ContactId.description: Salesforce ID of the associated contact

AccountId.description: Salesforce ID of the associated account

OwnerId.description: Salesforce ID of the case owner (user or queue)

ParentId.description: Salesforce ID of the parent case for case hierarchies

SuppliedName.description: Name supplied by the customer when the case was created via web or email

SuppliedEmail.description: Email address supplied by the customer

SuppliedPhone.description: Phone number supplied by the customer

IsClosed.description: Whether the case is in a closed status

IsEscalated.description: Whether the case has been escalated

CreatedDate.description: Date and time the case was created

ClosedDate.description: Date and time the case was closed

LastModifiedDate.description: Date and time the case was last modified

SlaStartDate.description: Start date for the SLA on this case

SlaExitDate.description: Date the case exited SLA tracking

CaseComment.description: A comment on a case record

IsPublished.description: Whether the comment is visible to the customer

CreatedById.description: ID of the user who created the comment
